The supplied filename/title is mislabeled: the native recording is DEAR DRIVER by NICO, Martin Hallenslev. Original supplied score identity is retained.

tracks.recording_verification: Complete acoustic reference comparison; see docs/music-source-audio-validation.json.

tempo.conclusion: Proxy only; no beat grid drives rainfall.

tracks.direction: Use clean short clusters and sharper spatial changes. Keep one recurring motif in the rain pattern so the choreography feels intentional, then break it at the section transition.

sections.name: motif: opening
sections.note: Recurring cluster gestures move and change spacing without a beat grid. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
